knowledge:
- key_parameters: maNormNN input=An object of class marrayRaw containing the two-channel microarray data to be normalized. ;; maNormNN output=An object of class marrayNorm containing the normalized log ratios.
- alternatives: Print-tip loess normalization (for simpler univariate intensity-only normalization). limma package (RGList or MAList objects can be used but must be converted to marrayRaw using the convert package).
- when_to_use: When analyzing two-color DNA microarray data (or paired single-channel data) that exhibit spatial and intensity-dependent biases.
- pitfalls: The package requires input data to be in marrayRaw format; users with limma RGList or MAList objects must convert them first using the convert package.

workflows.name: microarray_spatial_intensity_normalization
workflows.intent: Detect and correct spatial and intensity biases in two-channel microarray data using robust neural networks.
workflows.stages: 1. Load the raw microarray data ;; 2. Perform neural network normalization using maNormNN to obtain normalized log ratios
